context: A boss reviews an international delegation
purpose: Teach: 中山/日系/白人/ロバート/リチャード/ルイス/フランク/アブ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来週の海外視察、ロバート社長と打ち合わせを設定済みだ。
lines.en: I've already arranged the meeting with President Robert for next week's overseas inspection.
lines.style: Crisp, decisive authority. No excess breath. Direct eye contact. A man confirming what's done, not requesting input. Closed stance — settled matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。リチャードさんと、ルイス顧問も同席です。
lines.en: Yes. Richard and Advisor Lewis will be attending as well.
lines.style: Measured, attentive. Each detail placed deliberately. Slight nod-rhythm to the delivery. Present and listening — confirming back without embellishment or hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 通訳、フランクさんに頼んでくれ。白人専門の社交辞令も心得てる。
lines.en: Use Frank for interpretation. He understands high-level business protocol.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Settled judgment — not offering options. Brief pause before the second sentence to let the decision land. Calm confidence in the choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 日系顧客のフォロー、中山さんが現地で対応します。
lines.en: Nakayama will handle follow-up with Japanese clients on-site.
lines.style: Clear allocation of responsibility. Steady tempo. No doubt in the voice — this is already understood and confirmed. Slight formality in the structure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 視察地、農場周辺、アブの注意も周知だ。
lines.en: The inspection area is around the farms. Make sure everyone's aware of the horsefly precautions.
lines.style: Practical, grounded. A small smile underneath — details matter. No drama in the delivery. Fades gently on the final phrase, already moving to the next item.
